content.introduction: The earnings calendar for October 5-9 includes notable reports from several companies. On Monday, October 5, there are no noteworthy earnings reports scheduled. On Tuesday, October 6, before-the-open earnings reports are expected from Apogee Enterprises (APOG) at $0.63 per share, Lamb Weston (LW) at $0.59, Neogen (NEOG) at $0.05, and RPM (RPM) at 1.95. On Wednesday, October 7, after-the-close earnings reports are scheduled from a mid-cap stock with a forecast wider loss of 30 cents per share and Constellation Brands (STZ) at $3.55 per share.
body:
The mid-cap stock is scheduled to report fiscal 2027 first-quarter results after the closing bell on Wednesday. Wall Street forecast a wider loss of 30 cents per share vs three cents a year ago, though analysts also expect year-over-year revenue growth of 94.0% to $124.57 million.
